The evidence suggests a direct interaction between Isorhamnetin 3-robinobioside and ADP-ribosylation factor-like protein 3, which in turn influences C8166. This chain of targets implies a potential regulatory mechanism where Isorhamnetin 3-robinobioside modulates the activity of ADP-ribosylation factor-like protein 3, thereby affecting C8166.
